Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Britannica evidence and wrongly excluded Delmer Daves’s producer role even though the Britannica result explicitly labeled him “Screenwriter, Director & Film Producer.” The Planner then invented an arbitrary “scope_index” based on number of directing credits, conflating volume of output with breadth of professional roles, and prematurely marked the task complete without fully validating sources. This led to the incorrect conclusion that Phil Rosen had broader professional scope, whereas Daves actually has more distinct roles (screenwriter, director, producer).
